name: AP-7 Málaga–Estepona–Guadiaro toll (Ausol), special season
law: Tariffs of Autopista del Sol, Concesionaria Española, approved by Orden Ministerial of 18 December 2025, 2026: per troncal barrier (Calahonda, San Pedro, Manilva), Pesados 1 (two or three axles) and Pesados 2 (four or more), excluding 21% IVA; the special season (RD 436/1996, RD 1099/1999: June to September and the 17 days from the Friday before Holy Week to the Sunday after Easter). The lateral barriers on the ramps aren't priced: a trip joining or leaving at one is priced as through traffic.
vehicles: Pesados 1 (two or three axles) and Pesados 2 (four or more)
tolled_roads: AP-7 Málaga–Estepona (Calahonda, San Pedro) and Estepona–Guadiaro (Manilva), at the main-road barriers.
